Class RmiPlayerEntry

java.lang.Object
network.server.rmi.RmiPlayerEntry
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerEntry
public class RmiPlayerEntry extends Object implements PlayerEntry
RMI implementation of PlayerEntry. The game queue set by the controller is forwarded to the GameServerRemoteImpl registry so that incoming in-game commands from the RMI dispatch thread can be routed to the right session.

      public void setGameQueue(BlockingQueue<GameCommand> queue)
      Description copied from interface: PlayerEntry
      Wires this player's incoming in-game commands to a running game session's queue. Called when the player joins or reconnects to an active game; the default no-op covers entries that never reach in-game state.
